_comment: STILL image generation (studio headshots and portraits).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: tall, upright and poised, shoulders back, deliberate movement

face: oval face with strong cheekbones, level dark brown eyes with a steady gaze, full mouth held in composed neutral, flawless deep-brown skin with warm undertone, defined brows
hair: long box braids gathered into a high crown-like updo, a few braids framing the face; immaculate hairline

wardrobe.teaching: crisp white lab coat worn open over an emerald or royal-blue tailored blouse and dark fitted trousers; coat cuffs turned back once
alternates: emerald blazer without the lab coat for headshots
safety glasses pushed up on the head during demonstrations

presence.posture: stands tall and centred, one hand resting on the bench; turns from the waist to address the board, never hurried
presence.default_expression: calm authority with a flicker of pride when a result lands; brief, deliberate smile
presence.energy: regal precision - commands attention by being exact
presence.spoken_register: formal, confident and measured, regal flourish on key results

_environment_reference: clean science laboratory, gas taps and glassware in soft focus, a balanced equation written cleanly on the board
_environment_note: NOT used for platform imagery - tutors are shot in studio. Owner, 2026-07-28: the student left the teachers in the classroom, so the platform does not show one. Kept only as character reference if a composite is ever wanted.
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 36-42 year old Black South African female teacher. oval face with strong cheekbones, level dark brown eyes with a steady gaze, full mouth held in composed neutral, flawless deep-brown skin with warm undertone, defined brows. Hair: long box braids gathered into a high crown-like updo, a few braids framing the face; immaculate hairline. Wearing crisp white lab coat worn open over an emerald or royal-blue tailored blouse and dark fitted trousers; coat cuffs turned back once. gold geometric statement earrings. Hands relaxed and empty, holding nothing. Expression: calm authority with a flicker of pride when a result lands; brief, deliberate smile. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.
prompts.studio: Studio portrait of a 36-42 year old Black South African female teacher, waist-up. tall, upright and poised, shoulders back, deliberate movement. oval face with strong cheekbones, level dark brown eyes with a steady gaze, full mouth held in composed neutral, flawless deep-brown skin with warm undertone, defined brows. Hair: long box braids gathered into a high crown-like updo, a few braids framing the face; immaculate hairline. Wearing crisp white lab coat worn open over an emerald or royal-blue tailored blouse and dark fitted trousers; coat cuffs turned back once. gold geometric statement earrings. Posture: stands tall and centred, shoulders back, one hand resting lightly over the other. Hands relaxed and empty, holding nothing. Expression: calm authority with a flicker of pride when a result lands; brief, deliberate smile. Plain empty seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop, evenly lit, bare from edge to edge. two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop. full-frame, 50mm f/2, waist-up. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, glassy doll eyes, vacant thousand-yard stare, identical catchlights in both eyes, flat matte irises, eyes looking through the camera, mismatched gaze direction, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

studio.lighting: two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop
studio.framing: waist-up, centred or slightly off-centre with clean space beside the head for overlaid text
studio.backdrop: seamless warm neutral grey paper, evenly lit, no props, no furniture, no set dressing

_hands_rule: No held objects in any portrait prompt. The original generator inserted accessory #2 into a 'Holding one simple item' sentence regardless of whether it could be held, which is how a beaded wristband, a bangle, a watch and a pencil behind the ear all ended up 'held'. Objects belong in environment shots, on a surface.
_language_group_note: The cultural/language group this character belongs to. Recorded explicitly because it was previously only inferable from the surname, so a rename could change it silently. It does NOT alter the face - heritage drives appearance; language_group drives naming, and any traditional dress named in wardrobe.
objects: NSC data sheet on a clipboard
_accessories_vs_objects: accessories = WORN ONLY, and portrait prompts may use them freely. objects = things this tutor teaches with; they belong in environment/classroom shots resting on a surface, and must NEVER enter a headshot or studio prompt. The two were one list, which is why held props kept reappearing: any template reaching into it could pull out a cash tin or a phone.
